info.name: Fence OpenAPI Specification admin/user project API

params.name: program
params.description: The program to which the submitter belongs and in which the entities will be created. The `program` is the human-readable name, e.g. TCGA.

items.docs: Return the available resources at the top level of program ``program``, i.e. registered projects.

params.description: The program to which the submitter belongs and in which the entities will be created. The `program` is the human-readable name, e.g. TCGA.

items.docs: Register a project. The content of the request is a JSON containing the information describing a project. Authorization for registering projects is limited to administrative users.
